title: Gallery
description: Pictures from the media library as a grid, a slider with thumbnails or a mosaic of one large and two small; a click opens a picture over the page, the arrows page through the rest, and the slider can magnify a picture under the mouse.

schema.label: Pictures
schema.help: The title of a picture is printed under it.

schema.label: Mosaic
schema.help: One large picture and two smaller ones. Still shows the first three; a carousel pages through the rest in threes. The lightbox pages through them all either way.

schema.label: Columns
schema.help: At most; a narrow column shows fewer.

schema.label: Slides at a time
schema.help: At most; a narrow column shows fewer.

schema.label: Start over after the last slide
Turn on its own
schema.help: Stops under the mouse and in focus, has a pause button, and does not start for a visitor who asked for less motion.

schema.label: Open a picture over the page on click
Frame over the page
schema.help: The shape a picture opens in; the whole picture stays inside it, nothing is cut off.

schema.label: Magnify under the mouse
schema.help: Beside the picture where there is room for it, inside it where there is not. Two fingers zoom on a phone; a click still opens the picture over the page.
